# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Uno WebAssembly linking fix**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.155.3 release fixes Uno 6.x WebAssembly linking with the Skia renderer on .NET 9+.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno WebGPU linker flags match the target framework** — Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer no longer pass -sUSE_WEBGPU on .NET 9+, avoiding its conflict with Dawn's emdawnwebgpu port. .NET 8 retains the flag for its built-in WebGPU port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
